Format all code using the linter formatter:
make build_staging
make test_staging
make test_staging ONLY_TESTING=PocketCastsTests/YourTestClass/testMethodName
make test_staging ONLY_TESTING=PocketCastsDataModelTests
make test_staging ONLY_TESTING=PocketCastsServerTests
make test_staging ONLY_TESTING=PocketCastsUtilsTests

Modules under `Modules/`: DataModel (GRDB persistence), Server (Protocol Buffers; depends on DataModel/Utils), Utils (shared utilities/localization), DependencyInjection (DI). App: `podcasts/`; tests: `PocketCastsTests/`; watchOS: `Pocket Casts Watch App/`; widgets: `WidgetExtension/`; tools: `BuildTools/`.

All data operations go through `DataManager.sharedManager`:
let dataManager = DataManager.sharedManager
Use its podcast, episode, playlist, queue, folder methods as needed.
Located at: Modules/DataModel/Sources/PocketCastsDataModel/Public/DataManager.swift

Add strings to `podcasts/en.lproj/Localizable.strings` with translator comments; use generated `L10n`. Use snake_case keys: `feature_relevantIdentifier_description`; use positional specifiers (`%1$@`, `%2$@`), never string interpolation. Handle plurals manually with separate `_singular`/`_plural` keys.

Use `naturalContentHorizontalAlignment` instead of `.left`/`.right` for RTL support
Use `.natural` text alignment instead of `.left`
Never use `LocalizedStringKey` in SwiftUI - use `NSLocalizedString` with L10n
When styling Views, use `<REDACTED_USER> private var theme: Theme` and inject `.environmentObject(Theme.sharedTheme)` where the View is used.
Use `AppTheme.color(for: .primaryText01, theme: theme)` to access themed colors

brew i
